text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Shinko Windy completes the Tokai<n>Stakes with
supreme focus the whole<n>way through.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... I didn't realize Shinko Windy<n>could run like
that. She's a lot more<n>focused than when she first
debuted.

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, she seems more stable<n>recently. Less
distracted, and more<n>focused on the track in front of
her. I<n>guess she's good for more than just<n>a quick
laugh.

text_block_list.name: Windy Fan
text_block_list.text: E-exactly! Windy is a really talented<n>runner!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This is the result of her centering her<n>thoughts and
concentrating solely on<n>running. I'm starting to see
even<n>greater potential in her.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Wheeze... huff... huff... wheeze!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Yaaah!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Pheeew... I'm beeeat!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I ran real fast though, didn't I? It felt<n>really good,
too. Didn't get annoyed<n>one bit.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: (And hang on... I didn't even thinkabout biting anybody! Not even once!)

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
(That's weird... Normally, I really gotta<n>hold back the
urge to chomp<n>someone as I run...)

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: ...Heh, hehe.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: A-amazing... Windy's truly incredible!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
She's totally evolved since the last<n>time I watched
her. Even the<n>atmosphere in the venue feels a little
different.

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
The infamous biter ran better than<n>anyone
expected. I won't lie,<n>though—she had me on the
edge of<n>my seat! Ahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Just better than expected? They're<n>all still
underestimating Windy's skill.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Why can't they see her for how<n>strong she is?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: It doesn't make any sense!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
At times like this, it's a hero's job to<n>lend a helping
hand!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With the race over, we're about to<n>head home
when Shinko Windy<n>suddenly stops and looks back
at the<n>racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer... What didja think of my<n>running
today?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: ...Heh, hehe.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
You know, even I felt something was<n>different than
usual.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
It must've been that darkness switch<n>thing I've
been doing, 'cause I was<n>able to put all my
emotions into just<n>running.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
My desire to win, my frustrations, my<n>regrets, and
my anger... all of 'em<n>just blended together...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: And then, my urge to bite went poof!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Lemme promise you this—Windy the<n>biter is gone
for good!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Heck, there's no time for that when<n>the finish
line's just sittin' there,<n>waitin' for me to cross it
first!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I've got my ambition to achieve, so<n>I'm gonna
keep on chargin' ahead!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's truly grown stronger—that goesfor her running and her spirit. Havingbeen by her side this whole time, Isee it better than anyone else.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh! ♪ Hey! Let's chow down<n>on some miso
pork katsu before we<n>head home! Oh, and some
crispy fried<n>shrimp sounds good, too!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I gotta build up my energy reaaal high<n>before my
next race! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We take in some of the sights around<n>Chukyo
Racecourse before leaving<n>for the academy. While
riding on the<n>bullet train, I decide on our next race.
choice_data_list: Let's aim for the February Stakes!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Hehehe, so it's back to G1 races,<n>then. Bring it on!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I've heard that the biggest star in dirt<n>racing right
now is set to compete in<n>the February Stakes.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you're talking about the Queen of<n>Dirt, yeah?! I
heard she's super<n>powerful.
choice_data_list: Exactly! So if you beat her...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Then everyone will have to take meseriously!
choice_data_list: I know you're strong enough to beat her!
I know you're strong enough to beat her!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Of course I am! Wicked Windy fears<n>no opponent!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I'll show 'em a victory so awesome,<n>it's gonna go
down in history! Then<n>everyone'll see—

text_block_list.name: TV
text_block_list.text:
Moving on to our next story. In an<n>unexpected
twist, the Queen of Dirt<n>has pulled out of this year's
February Stakes despite being the<n>favorite.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Hmm? Hey, lackey! Turn up the<n>volume!

text_block_list.name: TV
text_block_list.text:
Boy, who'd have thought she'd opt<n>to race
overseas instead? It puts a<n>real damper on the
anticipation<n>surrounding the February Stakes.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: N-no way!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
How am I supposed to show off how<n>great I am
now?!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Arghhh! There's gotta be a way.<n>Can't we make it
some kinda huge<n>spectacle or something?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Unable to come up with any ideas,<n>we're left with
nothing to do but<n>prepare for the February Stakes
regardless. But at just that moment...
Dash, dash, dash! And... transform!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Ally of integrity and good kiddies<n>everywhere!
Justice Biko, ready for<n>action! ☆

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I've heard that you're entering the<n>February
Stakes, Windy!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
As such, I'm here to tell you<n>something vital—I'll
also be entering!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: You will?! Wh-what for?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: I'm going to become your rival!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Huh? You're gonna be... my rival?!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
That's right! I've gotten a lot stronger<n>now, so
let's compete to see who<n>comes out on top!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
If we both give it our best shot, I'm<n>sure it'll turn
out to be an amazing<n>race!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Then everyone watching will finally<n>realize how
great you are!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
So let's show them! We'll make<n>them
acknowledge our strength!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I see the point she wants to make.<n>The top
contender may have dropped<n>out of the February
Stakes...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But if Biko Pegasus were to take part<n>instead, it
could still be an electrifying<n>contest!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Biko... you...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hm... You're right that my strength<n>will stand out
more if I beat a strong<n>foe...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
But can ya even run on dirt?! Don't<n>go thinkin'
you're some hotshot just<n>'cause you're doing
kinda well on<n>turf!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Hmph. You'd best not underestimate<n>me! A hero
can race on any surface!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Just watch! Yaaah!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Haaahhh!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Biko Pegasus bursts down the track<n>right in front of
us. Her running is<n>exceptional—and not only that,
she<n>exhibits power easily rivaling that of a<n>career
dirt racer.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff... How was that?!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Wh-what the... Since when could you<n>do all that?!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh! It's all thanks to what you<n>taught me! If
I'm not satisfied with<n>things as they are, then I just
have to<n>strive to be greater.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
This is the result of all the effort I've<n>put in since
that day. It takes time, but<n>by never giving in, I'm
slowly getting<n>stronger.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I won't let things end in defeat. I'll<n>never give up
on my dream of<n>becoming a hero!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
You don't want things to stay as they<n>are either,
right?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: So let's have an epic clash for the<n>ages!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
We could really change things up!<n>And I don't just
mean the opinions of<n>the spectators or the critics...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: I'm talking about the whole world!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
You wanna change the world? Talk<n>about bitin' off
more than ya can<n>chew!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: I'm dead serious about this. We<n>could really do it!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
By combining our powers, we can flip<n>the world's
opinion of us on its head!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I don't remember making you my<n>rival! But anyone
brave enough to<n>pick a fight with me is goin' down!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I'mma crush you into pieces and<n>throw 'em all
over the track! People<n>will fear the name Wicked
Windy!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Hehe. ♪ That's what I wanted to<n>hear!
